skillDesc.a_hon: Eat a bun and instantly restore 20% of your realm's max swords.
skillDesc.ba_tam_loa: Yell into the loudspeaker: a sound wave bursts around you, knocking back every nearby enemy and reversing their sword rings.
skillDesc.ong_ba_vong: Sing a half-second lullaby (getting hit cancels it), then lie in the hammock for 4s: nearby enemies fall asleep for 2.5s, your swords don't chip, and enemy swords that break on you fly into your ring.
skillDesc.dai_ca_dep: Summon 2 minions for 8s, each carrying 30% of your swords — you don't lose a single one.
skillDesc.map_tra_sua: Spray boba to blind enemies for 5s: they can't pick anything up and their swords can't kill anyone (sword clashes still count).
skillDesc.co_ba_ganh: Set up 5 stalls in an arc to block the way for 6s — players of your realm or lower can't cut them, you walk right through. Banana peels along the stalls: step on one and slip, stunned for 1s.
skillDesc.su_phu_mi: Slurp a noodle at the nearest enemy in front: steal 25% of their swords into your ring (max 20% of your max swords, the rest drops). Nobody in front = miss, charge still used.
skillDesc.be_ti: Flex for 4s: swords twice as tough, immune to knockback, slow, root and stun.
skillDesc.shipper: Run 3× faster for 4s: pass through all obstacles (except zone edges), cleanse and ignore crowd control, vacuum up every orb and item nearby.
skillDesc.cu_rua: Hide in your shell for 5s: no sword breaks, can't be cut; popping out releases a knockback wave.

skillLines.a_hon: One bite and my swords are brand new!
skillLines.ba_tam_loa: TESTING, TESTING! Out of my way!

loadTips: There's no attack button. Your swords spin on their own — your job is to be in the right place.
A hit to the body is death at any realm. Down to 1 ring? Don't get greedy.
Extra swords drop as Sword Bundles. You can grab other people's bundles too.
Hold Shift for Blood Burn: run faster, paid for with EXP.
Skills recharge over time and stack charges — save them for when it counts.
Portals send you to a random zone. Nobody knows where, not even you.
The Heaven Gate in the middle of a zone leads straight to the Heavenly Court. One way only, no refunds.
Immortal Qi Altars erupt on a cycle. Be there at the right time, not just the right place.
More sword rings = longer reach, but people can spot you from farther away too.
The frozen lake is slippery: you can still run, you just can't brake.
Boba Big Boy covers your whole screen in boba. For those 5 seconds you can't pick anything up either.
Flip-Flop Boss calls two minions carrying half his swords. Don't charge into the middle.
Kill someone and you absorb 30% of their Spirit Qi, but you can't jump more than 2 major realms.
Breakable obstacles grow back. Empty now doesn't mean empty later.

seo.title: {name} — Cultivation .io game, play free in your browser
seo.description: Cultivate with hundreds of flying swords. Cut down rivals, steal their power, ascend to Dao Ancestor — if you can run fast enough. Free browser game.
intro: You are a fresh disciple with just one sword to your name. Collect Spirit Qi, gather more swords, and stack them into rings orbiting around you — the more rings, the longer your reach. Meet a weaker Daoist? Chase them down and steal their cultivation. Meet a stronger one? Run… while shouting very politely: "Fellow Daoist, please stop!"

Nine great realms from Qi Refining to Mahayana, then five Immortal realms up to Dao Ancestor. Five zones, random portals, ten ridiculous characters with ten signature skills. No download, no sign-up — type a name and you're in.

howto.t: on PC use WASD, arrow keys, or hold the mouse. On phones, drag your finger.
pick up Spirit Qi on the ground to add swords. They orbit you and strike on their own.
grind down a weaker player's sword ring until their body is exposed, then strike — you absorb their cultivation. Meet someone stronger? Run.
enough cultivation and you break through — you grow bigger, get more swords, and reach farther.
each character has a unique skill (Space key or round button) that recharges over time and stacks charges.
with only one ring left, a hit to the body ends your run at any realm — press "Play again" to restart from Qi Refining.

faq.a: Completely free. No top-ups, no item shop, and nothing you can buy to be stronger than other players.

faq.q: Can I play on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, right in your mobile browser — drag your finger to move. Turn your phone sideways for a wider view.
No. Type a name and play. No email, no password. Your name and character are remembered on your device for next time.

Yes — if you join at the same time you'll almost certainly meet, because new players always go into the busiest room. There are no private room codes yet, so to be sure, press "Play" at the same moment.

faq.q: Does it run on weak devices or slow internet?
faq.a: Yes. Nothing to download or install. If it stutters, press V to lower the graphics quality.
